observations.message: FYD Wave 1 fixup: current product UI implementation + ask test alignment
FYD step-0: proven renderer/mobile/URL-safety/service-card work
FYD Wave 1: ask authorized read-path, OwnerContext seam, BindingVerifier, retargeted ui tests

FYD-001: update hero badge assertions for honest claim labels

The ClaimBadge honesty fix (fa0f7efa) names the actual claim source.
The synthetic test business has no claimKind field, so its badge now
honestly reads Site record instead of the old unconditional
Website statement. Test intent (identity block renders) preserved.

FYD-001: update object-scope tests for real service objects

The 9 stale expectations hardcoded the deactivated demo-overlay
synthetic service (website-service-51de038c1defe8bd / Pergola).
Now: HAPPY_SVC points at a real extracted service (Repairs);
Coppersmith services test asserts the new positive behavior;
added a fail-closed test proving the private synthetic is
unknown_object for visitors. No product code changed.

FYD-001: honest provenance for overlay-authored (demo) content

New overlay-authored provenance kind. ClaimBadge names the actual claim
source per object (website statement / feed item / site record / demo
addition / mixed) instead of stamping everything Website statement. Ask
FYD classifies overlay content DEMO_SYNTHETIC with honest citation
labels. Demo content gets lower builder confidence and distinct dev
surfaces. Tests for badge and demo classification.

FYD-001: regenerate fixtures with extracted services

Machine-generated via fyd-proof-run/regen.ts (double-run byte-identical).
Happy Place: 5 services + 5 offers edges. Coppersmith: 4 services + 4
offers edges. Per-observation records persisted beside step1-report.json.

FYD-001: project service cards to Service objects with offers edges

parseRich emits service_card_name/description/href as direct html
observations tagged service-cards@2026-09-22; project() compiles each
card into ping.social.service@1 with content-derived ids
(business + sha256(entity key)), verbatim source labels, DIRECT_FACT
website_statement fields, and a business offers edge. PipelineOutput
now exposes fields for per-observation persistence.

FYD-001: deterministic HTML service-card detector with evidence locators

Two explicit detectors (elementor-cta-services, estimate-service-card)
emit titled+described+linked cards with verbatim labels, selector and
byte-span evidence detail. No LLM, no guessing: ambiguous mentions stay
out. 13 tests incl. order/reload/prior-ingestion id stability.

fyd object: evidence-gated ask capability on object views

The circle ask action appears only when the object carries something to answer from (summary text, a visible service, or contact evidence): no ask evidence means no ask action, never a dead question box. buildCapabilities is exported for tests.

fyd media: require provenance on published pipeline assets

validatePipelineManifest rejects any published asset missing provenance.sourceUrl or provenance.observedAt: a provenance-less item means the file did not come through the pipeline, so the whole manifest is rejected, never the item. Pinned by the Phase 4 pipeline-invariants suite.

fyd builder: ObjectRail doorway, CTA on home, must-win density preservation

The generator emits CTA on every home page and ObjectRail (the featured-object doorway) when the owner has featureable related objects. Eligibility counts featureable objects and gates ObjectRail on it. The planner density cap now preserves must-win components (Hero, BusinessSummary, Services, Products, Contact, CTA, AskFYD, ObjectRail) and only drops optionals. SiteSpec schema component vocabularies admit ObjectRail for service, post, product, person, and article schemas.

fyd ask: object-scoped questions, honest 200 fields, provenance and association branches

Ask FYD accepts an optional objectId: the question is answered about one object in the route tenant public graph with 1-hop related context (unknown or non-public ids fail closed as 404 unknown_object). The 200 body now carries the composer-computed unknowns, suggestedActions, and proposal instead of dropping them. The composer gains a provenance (how do you know?) branch with plain-language epistemic basis labels, an association branch citing related-object evidence as its own, and location answers through located_at relationships. FydCircle asks with siteId plus objectId and gains the circular Open Node control. The stale service-extraction expectation is updated for the intentional provenance claims.

fyd gate: repair orphan test loading and object lane tsx coverage

Four refresh tests and the resolve spike test used node:test but the orphan gate loads them through Jest: convert to Jest globals and drop .ts import suffixes. The resolve spike expectation is updated to the live fixture title. The object lane config now matches *.test.tsx and maps CSS modules to a class-name stub so card-node-projections runs in the lane and in the object-tsx orphan config.

fyd: per-object projection path (Phase 1)

- by-id.ts: loadObjectViewById / loadCircleProjectionById resolve ANY
  public object id in a tenant graph; null for unknown tenant/id or
  non-public object (no fixtures, no invented data).
- circle-adapter.ts: evidence-preserving ObjectView->CircleProjection
  adapter (tagline trim, topFacts, rights-authorized media else
  deterministic sha256 gradient via media gradientFor).
- related.ts: deterministic selectRelatedCircles over first-class
  relationships (both directions, predicate priority, id tiebreak).
- view.ts: extracted composeObjectView core; slug-keyed loaders
  behavior-identical (all 76 pre-existing tests green).
- 29 new tests; object lane 105/105 green; tsc clean.

fyd: css stub in ask/customize/media jest configs (gate repair)

5 suites failed to load because the ask, customize, and media lane
configs lacked the .css moduleNameMapper stub that the components
lane already had; Jest tried to parse object-circle.module.css as JS.
One line per config, harvested verbatim from the working components
config. No test files touched. Gate now 804/804 green.

fyd: owner patch panel on the /build surface (Phase 2+3)

[ Customize with FYD ] opens the conversational owner panel: the demo
owner-context banner is always visible, then request -> propose preview
(before/after, evidence impact, capability impact, truncated digests) ->
one-tap approve bound to baseStateDigest + baseViewDigest + patchDigest ->
receipt with event id and result digest. STALE PROPOSAL surfaces with a
fresh-proposal action; revert runs through the same propose/approve loop.
Mounted in BuildClient; the generated page chrome is otherwise untouched.

fyd: Ask FYD 3-class answers and digest-bound owner patch loop (Phase 2+3)

Ask: every citation carries claimClass (supported/derived); answer-level
class supported/derived/unknown. Trusted route /api/fyd/ask/[siteId]
derives tenant from path; body tenant mismatch refused (G3). Owner mode
grants no extra access.

Owner patch loop: propose (preview with before/after, evidence and
capability impact) -> approve bound to base owner-state digest, base
build-view digest, and patch digest -> apply -> 409 stale_proposal when
either base moved -> revert. Server-seeded demo actor; every response
labeled DEMO OWNER CONTEXT; body actor claims ignored (G4).

Tests: ask 46, overrides 17, builder 69, tenant 28. tsc clean on these
surfaces.

fyd: semantic diff engine and source refresh (Phase-4 Builder-3)

New modules only, no existing file modified.

- src/fyd/builder/semantic-diff.ts: twin diff engine. Change detection
  over objects, relationships, and claim refs; affected bindings via the
  manifest reverse walk (object-field and claim-ref granularity);
  owner-override conflict checks (prohibited positioning, owner-override
  collision, operating-constraint collision) that surface conflicts instead
  of silently applying them; typed, deterministic regeneration actions in
  execution order. No LLM inside.
- src/fyd/builder/source-refresh.ts: source re-ingestion carrying the
  owner layer through untouched. sha256 digest pair over the canonical
  owner layer is the machine-checkable proof that OwnerIntent and owner
  corrections survive the refresh.
- Tests: 16 new tests. Builder suite 69/69 green (53 pre-existing kept).

Export wiring in index.ts left as follow-up for the owning worker.

fyd: evidence-preserving inverse normalization in the object builder

Person to business works_for / member_of edges derive the forward
employs / has_member traversal the generator and runtime understand.
The derived edge reuses the source edge evidenceRef (same evidence, no
new claims); an explicit forward edge always wins. Every derivation is
recorded in attestation.derivations and covered by the attestation
digest. Coppersmith now emits a People section from its works_for
relationship with zero customer-specific code.

fyd: Builder-2 compiler core + tenant-scoped runtime entry points

Object builder (what is known): tenant-attested graph verification with
sha256 digest, schema catalog, evidence refs, visibility, relationship
legality including a predicate vocabulary and the private-leg refusal.

Website builder (how verified knowledge is presented): deterministic
data-driven planner over one eight-dimensional archetype vector,
evidence-bound generated copy with fail-closed verification, owner
intent layers, confidence axes, and per-section dependency manifests.

Tenant boundary: scoped wrappers over the real stores (read overrides,
apply owner command, get projection, Ask FYD, approval emit) that assert
the tenant key before any underlying I/O. Adversarial tests in both
directions.

/build/[siteId] now runs verifyObjectGraph then planSite. Dogfood
projection builder for ping-fyd included. RLS remains a designed
portable contract, not implemented.

fyd: checkpoint golden /build/[siteId] route with one featured object in the margin

The /build/[siteId] composition route renders the margin as the main product: one evidence-backed object (richest public non-owner object by deterministic evidence score) through the existing ObjectCircle doorway, with real description and provenance. Desktop shows a separated rail surface (rounded border, padding, shadow); narrow viewports collapse to a 44px drawer trigger with dialog semantics. Geometry decides placement via the collapseBelow breakpoint token. Ask FYD stays on the real path; no dead view/ask capabilities are emitted. ObjectPresence keeps its eligible-pool contract; composition selects the single featured object. Test lanes: components, archetypes, sitespec, proceduralize all green; tsc clean.

- scroll-reveal motion.div gets min-w-0 so the reveal wrapper never forces

- layout.tsx: extend chromeless to /sites/* so generated customer pages

Ask FYD evidence answers, customize propose/approve). 601/601 tests,

fyd/ask: permanent FYD-007 services-evidence tests (honest refusal + cited answer)

fyd(media): hero defects follow-up - logo never a hero, manifest production-truth validation, hero Why this?

DEFECT 1: heroMediaFor() no longer falls back to a logo-role asset when no
hero-role asset exists (a logo is brand identity, never a photographic
banner). Preference: hero role, then other photographic roles, then null
so the caller renders the honest typographic hero. The select() sort is
unchanged: galleries/object view intentionally still lead with logos.

DEFECT 2: manifests are now production-truth stamped and the read path
validates. ingestSiteMedia writes ingestRunId, pipelineVersion, and
preview; validatePipelineManifest() (applied on every getPipelineManifest
read) requires the production generator stamp, the ingest run id, a
matching pipeline version, a clear preview marker, and every media item
rights-acquirable with a digest and at least one variant. A preview or
stale or hand-written manifest is rejected exactly like a missing file.
run-ingest.ts --preview writes to manifests/preview/ (namespaced out of
the production read path) with preview: true. Both committed manifests
were regenerated through the real ingest pipeline (content-identical,
provenance stamps added).

AFFORDANCE 3: Hero renders a contextual Why this? drill-down (the generic
src/fyd/ui/why-this component) fed only with the media's own provenance
fields: photo source, rights basis, observed date, content digest.
No invented copy.

Tests: 20 new (hero logo rule incl. listObjectMedia logo-first pin,
manifest validation incl. read-path rejection of preview and
provenance-less files, hero Why this? present/absent). Media suite:
63/63 green. tsc --noEmit clean.

Move notConfiguredMessage to config.ts as the single definition
(re-exported from callback-flow.ts so both existing import sites

fyd owner: executable contract for the owner.correct-fact capability gate (order C)

Proves SESSION -> PING IDENTITY -> CONTROL RELATIONSHIP -> CAPABILITY
on the pure evaluation seam: seeded demo actor resolves to controller,
strangers resolve to none, owner.correct-fact allows for the controller
and denies otherwise, deny is the default across all capabilities,
owner.publish stays denied even for the controller, and the audit view
always carries the demo-scaffolding marker. The 403-on-deny half is
enforced by the overrides route; EVENT -> PROJECTION is proven in
owner-events.test.ts.
fyd(identity): replace Apple-literal seam test with Google-only provider-seam proof
fyd(identity): Google auth routes, link/unlink, route tests, demo-owner regression

fyd owner: wire owner.correct-fact through the capability chain

Add the owner.correct-fact capability (controller may correct
low-risk facts; external effects stay on their own denied
capabilities) and enforce SESSION -> PING IDENTITY -> CONTROL
RELATIONSHIP -> CAPABILITY -> PROPOSE/APPLY -> EVENT -> PROJECTION
in the overrides approve stage via the new demo-chain module.
A denied verdict returns 403 and writes nothing; the session
identity is recorded for audit only (authentication alone never
grants mutation). The demo actor path is kept but labeled
truthfully as demo scaffolding in the audit trail, returned with
every approve response and logged server-side.
fyd(identity): sessions, CSRF, audit log, config, injectable callback flow

fyd owner: store becomes an adapter over the event log

applyOwnerCommand/parseOwnerCommand/readOverrides keep their public
API; commands now append one provenance-backed event and return the
projected state. revert-contact-field appends owner.restored-fact
instead of deleting the correction. Redundant no-op operations record
owner.confirmed-fact. New regression tests: event identity stability,
provenance completeness, replay determinism (byte-identical fold,
digest match vs the live read path), append-only revert, transparent
v1 migration, fail-closed reducer.

fyd owner: append-only provenance-backed event log

Replace the mutable owner map with an event log. Every owner
transition records actor, target fact, previous basis, new
value/state, timestamp, content-hash event identity (reusing the
canonicalizeJson transition-id substrate, generator fyd-owner@1),
and an evidence/provenance reference. Event types: confirmed,
corrected, hid, restored, added. reduceOwnerEvents is the pure
projection fold; v1 files migrate transparently on read.

fyd: regression tests for hero media selection and Hero render wiring

select.test.ts pins the hero selection rule against the real pipeline
manifests (happy-place null, coppersmith hero-role asset, determinism,
unknown-site null) and the generic Hero render contract (image with
honest alt when threaded, typographic with no invented image when null).

fyd: wire media pipeline into the generic Hero via RenderContext.heroMedia

The canonical selector (heroMediaFor) runs once at the server render
seam in each site page; the serialized DisplayMedia is threaded through
SiteClient into RenderContext. The Hero renders the image banner when
present and stays typographic when null. No customer-specific code:
the same path serves every site. Type-only media import keeps the
client bundle away from the server-only media store.
fyd(identity): provider-account binding, one-identity semantics, file store

fyd net: canonical SSRF gate + tiny anonymous abuse boundary

Move the media pipeline SSRF gate to fyd/net as the single canonical
fetch implementation (media/safe-fetch.ts becomes a re-export shim).
Add injectable DNS/fetch deps for tests, bracketed IPv6 literal handling,
and caller-respecting maxBytes on safeFetchPage.

New tiny abuse boundary (order G): crawl/page budget, per-origin and
global concurrency semaphore, in-flight dedupe plus bounded TTL cache,
token-bucket rate limiting and per-window generation quota with a
combined AnonymousGate. No CAPTCHA; in-memory single-instance, documented.

Tests: 35 pass (npx jest --config src/fyd/net/jest.config.cjs).

fyd lane C: owner correction UI on the object page and manage surface

The object page shows the effective contact value with an honest
owner-corrected note and a Source vs owner section: Owner says /
Source says, drift notice, and a WhyThis trail (basis, demo actor,
timestamp, source snapshot, store location). The manage surface keeps
its demo-mode warning and gains contact correction controls: the
proposal panel shows what the site says vs what the owner says, and

fyd lane C: Ask FYD cites owner corrections as owner evidence

Corrected contact fields cite a dedicated field-level evidence ref
(the correction) instead of the business object, so the Why-this view
can no longer mislabel an owner-set number as a website statement.
The answer states the owner value, names the site value, and carries
an owner_override classification. citationFor names Owner correction
as the source for field-kind refs. Adds a unit test pinning the
citation basis and source.

NOTE: this file carried pre-existing uncommitted worktree changes
(fixture-based render migrated to the PING-backed read seam with
generateMetadata, ownerName, shared site-client); that migration is the
base this commit keeps, not Lane D authorship. Lane D hunks only:

from the projection, compile the base spec from facts, then apply the
approved intent OVER it (facts and theme untouched), and render the
demo-owner customization panel. Verified end to end: an approved
reorder_section directive for Services moved it to position 0 in the

view.ts reads the composed (owner-overlay applied) graph so the contact
block carries the effective owner value, and exposes fieldCorrections
with SOURCE SAYS X / OWNER SAYS Y plus drift flags. The overrides API
snapshots the raw source value at approval time and records the demo
actor label on set-contact-field commands. lab-adapter satisfies the
widened ObjectView type.

fyd(data): read seam with digest-verified presentation-intent block

NOTE: this file was untracked worktree work (the PING-backed read
seam) before Lane D; this commit records it as the base Lane D builds
on. Lane D additions: the PresentationIntentBlock type, the
PingProjection.presentationIntent field, and validatePresentationIntent,
which fails closed when meta.presentationIntentDigest is present
without a matching block, or when the block was tampered with. The
intent layer is validated and returned separately; facts remain in the
graph and the design system is untouched.

fyd lane C: owner field correction types (OwnerFieldCorrection)

Adds the OwnerFieldCorrection record and PingObject.ownerFieldCorrections:
the read model carries the effective (owner-winning) value in fields[]
and keeps SOURCE SAYS X alongside OWNER SAYS Y on the correction record,
with the correction timestamp, demo actor label, basis, and a derived
sourceDrifted flag. Read-model state only; the PING dump never writes it.

fyd(owner-mode): demo-owner customization panel and approval API

Conversational panel (parse -> digest-bound proposal -> before/after
review -> explicit Approve) mounted inside the demo-owner area, which
is conspicuously labeled as not real authentication. New deny-by-
default capability owner.customize-approve. The approval endpoint
requires the demo-owner env flag, a private-network host
(isPrivateHost gate), the capability, and an exact freshly re-derived
proposal with matching digest; tampered or stale proposals fail closed
(409). Approval journals a presentation-intent overlay op to the demo
journal only; the projection dump persists it as a separately digested
block. Unsupported requests return unsupported, never reinterpreted.

fyd(customize): typed intent parsing and deterministic proposal pipeline

Plain-English customization requests become typed intents
(promote_first, feature_object, hide_section, show_section),
resolved against the live SiteSpec/ObjectGraph, compiled into
digest-bound SiteSpec proposals with before/after review cards.
Unsupported requests return unsupported, never reinterpreted.
The apply layer is pure: presentation/order only, facts stay in
the graph, theme changes are refused. 20 tests green.

fyd: regenerate @2 manifests + WebP derivatives for both demo sites

rejected (brand mark, non-image URL, off-origin avatar kept
reference-only). happy-place: 0 acquired, 1 rejected

fyd: media provenance API (GET /api/fyd/media)

Exact provenance for a known site+digest: source URL/page,
observed_at, rights source/basis, derivative chain with
digests and served URLs. 404 for unknown site, unknown
digest, or reference-only assets (never retrievable).
Reference-only observations stay source references in the
manifest; they are not acquirable through this API.

ObjectView loads media through listObjectMedia (semantic
relationships on the attached graph), not a manifest scan.
derivePresence selects logo/hero/gallery via the same
attachment (Business represented_by Media). Circle background
reads the pipeline manifest store with observedAt falling
back to the manifest generation timestamp when a site has no
acquired media. bundle-media reads manifests fresh from disk;
Ask FYD bundles the same PING graph, same spec generator,
same manifest store. No production fixture fallback.

fyd: managed media pipeline core (fyd-media@2)

Rights/source classification before fetch: unclear provenance is
reference-only and never acquired. Semantic attachment
(Business represented_by Media, Service illustrated_by Media,
Project has_media Media) via attach.ts; shared selector in
select.ts. Byte validation through sharp (8000px/axis, 64Mpx
caps), WebP-only product derivatives (thumbnail 480w, card 768w,
hero 1600w, blur 10w, no upscaling). Bounded fetch: 15MB,
20s, 5 redirects, SVG rejected. Digest-verified provenance
chain; /fyd-media/<sha256>/<variant> layout.

lane-a: map corrupt-projection throw to structured 503 in Ask FYD

POST /api/fyd/ask called answerAskFyd with no try/catch; a corrupt,
missing, or digest-tampered projection made getSiteBundle throw, and the
throw escaped the route handler as an empty-body HTTP 500, bypassing the
route error mapping.

- visitor-answer.ts: wrap the bundle/projection load in try/catch and
  return a new AskFydOutcome kind projection_unavailable (honest
  unknown: names the failure, states the answer is unknown; internal
  detail is logged server-side only, never leaked to the visitor).
- route.ts: map projection_unavailable to a structured 503
  {ok:false, kind, error, attempted, answerUnknown:true}; add a
  defensive try/catch around the pipeline so no future throw can leak
  an empty 500 (structured internal_error 500 instead).
- jest config: widen the ask-lane test scope to include the
  /api/fyd/ask route tests.
- tests: throwing-loader unit case, plus route-level integration tests
  for corrupt JSON, tampered digest (both 503), and recovery (200).

Live proof on the dev server: corrupted happy-place.json -> HTTP 503
with the structured body; restored byte-identical (sha256-verified) ->
HTTP 200 with the same evidence-backed answer.
